agentReceipts.description: Document-owned work/request receipts prevent duplicate application after transport failures. Retained by TIFF/JSON and Undo, omitted from layer fragments and when empty. Combined metadata limit 4 MiB.

comments.description: Optional local canvas threads, omitted when empty and from layer fragments. Anchors use bottom-left UV and may lie outside the canvas after Crop. TIFF stores a separate optional comments block; annotations never alter composite pixels.

commentNumberSequence.description: Highest assigned comment number. Retained after deletion, omitted from layer fragments. Zero starts a fresh sequence.

lights.description: Document lights shared by FX and Shader Graph. Bottom-left canvas-pixel XY and height Z; HDR color, no inter-layer shadows. Stable IDs; list order is the zero-based shader index, including disabled sources.

ambientColor.description: Linear HDR ambient tint. Multiplies the Ambient strength in global lighting; alpha is unused. White preserves neutral illumination.

pixelScale.description: Logical pixel lengths multiplied once at rendering/painting. Does not change source texel indices, canvas buffer dimensions, antialiasing grids, normalized layer coordinates or UI pixels.

number.description: Permanent document-local display number. Zero/omitted is assigned once in list order after the highest existing number. Assigned positive values must be unique.

useAuthorColor.description: Track the creator's profile color. Omitted/false preserves the stored manual color, including older comments. The color field retains the latest portable snapshot.

colorAuthorId.description: Optional local author profile GUID for automatic color updates across nickname changes. Not a Unity account or project ID.

resolved.description: Resolved status. Mutually exclusive with awaitingReview; both false means In Progress.

awaitingReview.description: Awaiting Review status. Explicit task state, never changed by opening or reading a thread.

authorId.description: Optional local author profile GUID, independent of the discussion color.

authorColor.description: Portable author color snapshot. All-zero means absent: resolve the local profile/name or use the author-name hue. The UI always displays an opaque author stripe.

editedUtcTicks.description: Zero means never edited. Otherwise UTC ticks at or after createdUtcTicks; preserves the original author and creation time.

agentContentHash.description: API provenance fingerprint. Editing message content invalidates its agent-only status for feedback guards.

assetGuid.description: Persistent project asset GUID; localId identifies a sub-asset. Missing targets remain references.

WhimTexCommentAttachment.description: Exactly one nonempty layerId, assetGuid or nonnull mask. Layer/mask references use localId 0. Empty UI draft fields are omitted before storage.

WhimTexCommentMask.description: Version 1: lossless Deflate/base64 R8 coverage, bottom row first, cropped to nonzero bounds. SHA-256/base64 checks decoded bytes. At most 16,777,216 pixels per mask and 67,108,864 per document. localToCanvas maps local bottom-left UV to current canvas UV, finite invertible affine only. Original pixels survive Crop/Scale/Orientation; consumers sample at pixel centres with nearest filtering. Mask IDs are unique in the document.

direction.description: Directional: toward source. Spot/Area: emitted axis, default [0,0,-1] when omitted. The sampled HLSL direction always points from surface to source.

angle.description: Spot outer cone full angle in degrees.

softness.description: Spot edge width as a fraction of the half-angle; zero is a hard edge.

size.description: Area width/height in canvas pixels. Disk uses size.x as its diameter.

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees about the emitted axis frame; rotates the Area rectangle or Spot Cookie.

cookie.description: Optional Spot Texture2D asset reference. Linear RGB times alpha modulates radiance. Cached atlas bounds each image to 1024 pixels and the shared atlas to 4096; dense sets may be reduced further. Null disables the projection.

fx.description: Document-owned shared Shader programs in Code or Graph mode. Both modes and a complete preset fallback are embedded. Internal $ref identities are supported; external Material, Shader and ShaderFX asset references are rejected.

transform.description: Omitted transform.tiling defaults to Source for every layer. The source declares its stable policy: geometry and procedural generators use Unbounded; Drawing, Text, groups and image effects use Clip; File inherits its bound texture's U/V wrap modes. Never inferred from preview or render-cache textures. Explicit modes, including Clip, survive Compact writing and Shape/Text conversion.

booleanOperation.description: Operation when this layer is an operand of a Boolean Group. Bottom enabled operand is the base, so its operation is ignored. Retained outside Boolean Groups.

sourceCanvasSize.description: Source reference canvas dimensions retained by Crop. [0,0] uses the current canvas; otherwise both dimensions must be positive and their product at most 16,777,216. Keeps Noise, ordinary Pattern and uninitialized Drawing sources at their original pixel scale. Not a source-image resolution, crop rectangle or rendering cache.

sourcePixelScale.description: Source pixel-scale reference retained at the first canvas change; zero uses the current document pixelScale.

sourceCanvasScale.description: Per-source-axis physical pixel metric accumulated by Scale, including nested rotations and quarter turns. Perspective uses the Jacobian at the source centre. Crop and Orientation retain it. Multiplies sourceCanvasSize only for pixel-sized Pattern/Grain parameters; source buffers and dimensionless Noise retain their original basis.

groupFxInLayerSpace.description: On groups only, preserve a converted source layer's LayerToLocal FX coordinates instead of the ordinary group's canvas coordinates. Character Text-to-Vector sets this true; non-group layers ignore it. Retained by save and Undo.

ShaderFX.description: Document-owned Shader effect with an editable shared program. Graph and Code modes retain independent data. Graph SampleInput reads the image entering this effect in its chain. active controls application. $ref shares an owned FX object within the document; external ShaderFX assets are unsupported.

mode.description: Select an independent stored mode without conversion or draft application.

workingGraph.description: Last successfully compiled graph with functions, include backups, parameters and bound node-input values. Optional; null means no saved working Graph. Rendering restores this snapshot while graph retains an unfinished draft. TIFF permits pending/failed drafts only with a working version in the selected mode.

draftCode.description: Editable WhimTex HLSL ApplyFX/@param draft. Saving or changing mode does not apply it.

workingCode.description: Last successfully compiled HLSL source used by Code rendering; not a compiled GPU binary. Null means no accepted Code source. Omission alongside an explicit code draft also means null, so a code-only FX recipe can apply its supplied source. workingCodeParameters retains working values; draftCodeParameters supplies them when no saved values exist. Retained while Graph is active.

draftCodeParameters.description: Accepted Code declarations and current values, including control metadata and texture identities. Retained independently of draftGraph.parameters. Array replacement; no reparse of draft code.

workingCodeParameters.description: Last working Code declarations and bound values. Retained separately so a broken draft can change or remove declarations without losing the rendered result. Omitted/empty values use draftCodeParameters when preparing the saved source.

presetId.description: Optional @preset GUID in N or D form; editor writes lowercase N. A nonempty ID requires presetVersion >= 1. No Unity asset GUID or content/path matching.

presetVersion.description: Exact expected preset version. Zero/omitted only without a preset ID. Missing, invalid or differently versioned sources use the complete saved program and retain this reference.

ShaderProgram.description: Editable program shared by Shader layers and FX. mode selects Graph or Code without conversion. Both branches, parameter values, functions, subgraphs and embedded include sources persist in all write modes. presetId/presetVersion link the same catalog; the full local program remains usable and editable without the preset. Layer input settings and FX activation belong to the host. A Self texture is supported by FX only; layer hosts reject Self in either branch. Code text is limited to 8 MiB UTF-8 per field; TIFF deduplicates/compresses shader source text in a shared table with a 32 MiB budget.

sources.description: Embedded HLSL source archive. At most 32 MiB of UTF-8 text across all entries, 8 MiB per entry, 32768 include directives and 64 nested modules. Capture and validation retain every source, including inactive preprocessor branches. TIFF deduplicates/compresses text across all graphs; JSON retains plain code.

notes.description: Editor annotations only; excluded from shader/render fingerprints. IDs are unique across nodes, notes and groups. Groups contain node/note IDs in elements; one group per element, no nesting.

groups.description: Editor annotations only; excluded from shader/render fingerprints. IDs are unique across nodes, notes and groups. Groups contain node/note IDs in elements; one group per element, no nesting.

ShaderGraph.description: Shared Shader/FX fragment graph, version 1. Parameters retain their control declarations and stable IDs. Parameter.parameterId refers to a root parameter; SubGraphInput.parameterId refers to an input interface ID. Sub Graph instances reference the embedded subGraphs table and use stable interface IDs as port keys. Definitions share root parameters/functions/sources; nesting is limited to 16, recursion is forbidden, and compilation expands at most 4096 nodes. HDR values are retained. Arrays replace the complete corresponding graph data.

valueType.description: Declared HLSL scalar/vector type, independent of the control presentation. Resource parameters have no numeric valueType.

integerValues.description: Exact integer/bool components; active count and signedness follow valueType. Bool components are 0/1.

hasMinimum.description: Enables the corresponding parameter-level Float limit. A Graph Seed parameter keeps both flags false with Range off, while its Seed control always keeps both flags true. A single enabled Float bound must be hard; soft Float boundaries require both finite limits with minimum < maximum. Vector2 ranges require both finite hard limits with minimum < maximum; cyclic ranges also require both hard limits.

hasMaximum.description: Enables the corresponding parameter-level Float limit. A Graph Seed parameter keeps both flags false with Range off, while its Seed control always keeps both flags true. A single enabled Float bound must be hard; soft Float boundaries require both finite limits with minimum < maximum. Vector2 ranges require both finite hard limits with minimum < maximum; cyclic ranges also require both hard limits.

softMinimum.description: Makes the corresponding enabled scalar limit soft. Float soft boundaries require both finite limits with minimum < maximum; manual values may exceed a soft endpoint. Seed Random uses its control's valueMinimum/valueMaximum as inclusive generation bounds while manual seeds remain within -16777216..16777216 for valueType float. Not a soft Vector2 interval or cyclic limit.

softMaximum.description: Makes the corresponding enabled scalar limit soft. Float soft boundaries require both finite limits with minimum < maximum; manual values may exceed a soft endpoint. Seed Random uses its control's valueMinimum/valueMaximum as inclusive generation bounds while manual seeds remain within -16777216..16777216 for valueType float. Not a soft Vector2 interval or cyclic limit.

cyclicRange.description: Shared Code/Graph cyclic range, equivalent to [min % max] HLSL metadata. Vector2 endpoints may cross the seam; Float numeric edits repeat while slider dragging stays bounded. Two hard finite limits with min < max are required. Ordinary Vector2 ranges order X <= Y; cyclic ranges retain start/end direction and full-cycle winding.

pixelUnits.description: Shared Code/Graph numeric px metadata; the retained logical value is multiplied by document pixelScale once when uploaded. Preserve it in full document copies; do not pre-scale stored values. Not applicable to Enum, Seed, Point, Normal or Transform2D.

ShaderParameter.description: Shared Code/Graph parameter declaration and current value. Graph Enum uses floatValue and float option values in controls[].optionNames/optionValues. The Graph Seed selection stores type Float, numeric valueType float (null uses that native type), and a control with type Seed, seed=true, hasMinimum=true, hasMaximum=true and explicit valueMinimum/valueMaximum. With Range off, the parameter's own hasMinimum/hasMaximum remain false while the control retains both flags true and valueMinimum=-16777216/valueMaximum=16777216. floatValue is integral in -16777216..16777216 inclusive, even with soft limits. Point uses vectorValue.xy; Normal supplies normalized vectorValue.xyz with (0,0,1) fallback; Transform2D uses transformValue. Preserve stable id, controls (including labels/options/ranges), pixelUnits and all values in complete document/graph copies, including inactive program branches. Graph authoring through Transform2D does not add typed integer ports, expanded color/toggle vectors, layout/condition authoring or preview authoring; the shared model also retains Code metadata.

customKeys.description: Optional retained manual data. When nonempty: one to 64 keys in each channel, at most 64 distinct color times across channels 0..2, unique positive IDs, channel times increasing by at least 0.000001. Keys are independent. Markers cluster all channels sorted by time/id within 0.00001 of each earliest anchor, not transitively; color/alpha filtering happens inside these clusters. Groups are never serialized; the obsolete link field is rejected. Empty/null allowed only outside Custom.

customCurveFormat.description: 1 is required with Custom Bezier keys; 0 means no manual data.

customColorMode.description: Required with nonempty customKeys. Linear/Gamma use RGB, Perceptual uses L/a/b, Hue uses L/C/H; alpha is channel 3. Color conversion must explicitly refit the curves; changing this field reinterprets values.

customApproximationError.description: Saved conversion diagnostic: maximum observed relative RGB/alpha sample deviation, not a certified bound. It does not affect evaluation.

colorSpace.description: Technical encoding of stored color keys, independent of colorMode.

smoothness.description: Used only by Blend/Balanced. Smooth, Adaptive, Fixed and Custom retain but ignore it.

WhimTexGradient.description: Independent color model and scalar interpolation. colors/alphas/colorMode retain automatic data. Custom uses independent customKeys/customColorMode; inactive automatic and manual data remain stored in every write mode. huePath, smoothness, midpoint and chromaCorrection do not change Custom curves. Retired mode and transition fields are unsupported.

inWeight.description: Fraction of adjacent time span; unweighted sides use 1/3.

outWeight.description: Fraction of adjacent time span; unweighted sides use 1/3.

inMode.description: Free, ClampedAuto, Linear, Constant (previous value) or ConstantNext (next value). Joined sides must both be Free or ClampedAuto. Weighted Bezier evaluation uses AnimationCurve.

outMode.description: Free, ClampedAuto, Linear, Constant (previous value) or ConstantNext (next value). Joined sides must both be Free or ClampedAuto. Weighted Bezier evaluation uses AnimationCurve.

previewParameters.description: Ordered @param names explicitly passed after float2 uv to previewFunction. Empty retains the UV-only/optional-own-value signature. Referenced types must match exactly.

containers.description: Outer-to-inner HLSL inspector layout path: Group, Foldout, Tabs, Tab. Derived from metadata, independent of shader values. Selected tabs and foldout expansion are editor-local and not stored here.

hasMinimum.description: For type Seed, both hasMinimum and hasMaximum must explicitly be true for validation and Random, including with the parameter's Range UI off. They describe the control's numeric generation bounds in valueMinimum/valueMaximum, not the parameter's UI range flags. Other controls use these flags to enable their corresponding limits.

hasMaximum.description: For type Seed, both hasMinimum and hasMaximum must explicitly be true for validation and Random, including with the parameter's Range UI off. They describe the control's numeric generation bounds in valueMinimum/valueMaximum, not the parameter's UI range flags. Other controls use these flags to enable their corresponding limits.

softMinimum.description: Makes the corresponding enabled scalar limit soft. Float soft boundaries require both finite limits with minimum < maximum; manual values may exceed a soft endpoint. Seed Random uses its control's valueMinimum/valueMaximum as inclusive generation bounds while manual seeds remain within -16777216..16777216 for valueType float. Not a soft Vector2 interval or cyclic limit.

softMaximum.description: Makes the corresponding enabled scalar limit soft. Float soft boundaries require both finite limits with minimum < maximum; manual values may exceed a soft endpoint. Seed Random uses its control's valueMinimum/valueMaximum as inclusive generation bounds while manual seeds remain within -16777216..16777216 for valueType float. Not a soft Vector2 interval or cyclic limit.

cyclicRange.description: Shared Code/Graph cyclic range, equivalent to [min % max] HLSL metadata. Vector2 endpoints may cross the seam; Float numeric edits repeat while slider dragging stays bounded. Two hard finite limits with min < max are required. Ordinary Vector2 ranges order X <= Y; cyclic ranges retain start/end direction and full-cycle winding.

optionNames.description: Enum option names paired by index with optionValues. Retain names and order; the selected parameter stores the associated value, not this array index.

optionValues.description: Enum values paired by index with optionNames. Graph Enum uses finite float values, including fractional values; Code may use other declared scalar types.

valueType.description: Declared HLSL scalar/vector type, independent of the control presentation. Resource parameters have no numeric valueType.

valueMinimum.description: Seed control's inclusive numeric validation/Random bound; explicitly supply both valueMinimum and valueMaximum. Graph float Seed with Range off requires -16777216 and 16777216 respectively; with Range on, use the parameter's selected minimum/maximum. Both control hasMinimum/hasMaximum flags remain true in either case.

valueMaximum.description: Seed control's inclusive numeric validation/Random bound; explicitly supply both valueMinimum and valueMaximum. Graph float Seed with Range off requires -16777216 and 16777216 respectively; with Range on, use the parameter's selected minimum/maximum. Both control hasMinimum/hasMaximum flags remain true in either case.

enableIf.description: Enclosing @enableif scalar comparisons, combined with AND. Inspector controls remain visible and become disabled when any condition fails; stored values and shader evaluation are unchanged.

ShaderParameterControl.description: Retained shared control metadata. label is the display label; optionNames and optionValues are parallel Enum tables. Graph Enum values are floats, not implicit option indices. Preserve each control's type, valueType, order, independent hard/soft limit flags and cyclicRange. A Seed control always requires hasMinimum=true and hasMaximum=true for ShaderSeed.Validate/Random, independently of the parameter's UI range flags. Graph Seed uses valueType float and explicit valueMinimum/valueMaximum: -16777216/16777216 with Range off, or the selected UI endpoints with Range on. Manual edits, random values and range endpoints remain exact integers within the float seed domain. Code seeds may use other declared scalar types. Existing layout, condition and preview metadata must survive copying even though their Graph authoring is outside this parameter-parity scope.

valueType.description: Graph port type. Transform2D is a resource-like transform reference, not a numeric vector or matrix port; ApplyTransform2D produces Float2 Local/Input coordinates. Enum and Seed parameters use Float, Point uses Float2, Normal uses normalized Float3. Dynamic numeric ports accept only Float-Float4/Color; resource passthrough uses the exact resource type. No typed integer ports are introduced by these parameter controls.

constant.description: Constant node selection. Emits a Float HLSL literal; arbitrary values use parameters or unconnected inputs.

swizzle.description: Swizzle node mask: 1–4 xyzw/rgba letters (case-insensitive) or _ for zero. Output width is mask length. Input width is max(source width, highest mask component); connected scalars repeat and shorter vectors gain zeros. Unconnected values expose inferred components directly. Invalid masks may be retained as uncompiled drafts.

expression.description: Expression node HLSL formula. Variables become case-sensitive input names; valueType selects Float-Float4 for all inputs and Out. Functions, numeric literals, comments, casts and swizzles do not create inputs. Empty expression returns zero. Invalid expressions may be retained as uncompiled drafts.

loopPartnerId.description: ForBegin/ForEnd partner node ID. Endpoints must reference each other in the same graph. Initial sets the numeric/Color state type; Index starts at zero, Value carries state, Result returns the final state. Other node kinds leave this field null.

parameterId.description: Parameter: root graph.parameters[].id. SubGraphInput: the enclosing definition's inputs[].id; output port is Out. Interface nodes cannot be created in the root graph.

option.description: Zero-based node mode; use discovery modes for kind-specific values. CausticsNoise Algorithm: 0=OpenSimplex2S, 1=Simplex (default); both share inputs including optional Dispersion=1 (nonnegative, no upper limit) and output the complete 0..1 profile as Float Value and RGB Color (alpha=1). Dispersion affects only Color. RangeMask: 0=Linear (default), 1=Smooth inward falloff; scalar Center=0.5, Width=0.2, Feather=0; dynamic In/Out use component-wise numeric values without color conversion. Width includes transitions, Feather clamps to 0..Width/2, Width<=0 is empty. GaborNoise Profile: 0=Sine, 1=Triangle, 2=Pulse, affecting only Phasor. PhaseOffset (cycles, default 0) shifts Value, Phase, Phasor, Gradient and Curl. Intensity is independent. Width controls the Pulse Phasor. Blur/Sharpen/Dilate/Erode: 0=3x3, 1=5x5, 2=9x9; EdgeDetection has a fixed 3x3 Sobel kernel. RadialBlur: 0=Spin, 1=Zoom; DirectionalBlur has no mode. RGBShift: 0=Radial (default), 1=Directional, 2=Triangle. Color In/Out, Amount=2 document pixels and Blend=1. Radial uses Center=(0.5,0.5) and Falloff=1. Directional and Triangle use Angle=0 degrees. Triangle samples the three channels at equal radii in directions 120 degrees apart. SlopeBlur: 0=Average, 1=Min, 2=Max. BilateralBlur: 0=Source, 1=Custom (adds dynamic numeric/Color Guide, default scalar 0; Out follows In only). TileUV: 0=Grid, 1=Staggered (activates RowOffset). RotateVector: 0=2D (Float2 In/Out), 1=3D (Float3 In/Out, adds Axis). Flipbook: 0=Bottom to Top, 1=Top to Bottom. Dither: 0=Bayer 4x4, 1=Bayer 2x2, 2=Bayer 8x8.

fractal.description: Fractal node: FBm (default), Ridged, PingPong, Multifractal, HybridMultifractal, HeteroTerrain or RidgedMultifractal; numeric/Color In is repeated in the 2D graph domain, not through per-noise WT fractal evaluation. Octaves=3, Lacunarity=2, Gain=0.5, WeightedStrength=0, PingPongStrength=2, Bias=1, Feedback=2 and SeedStep=1 are input ports. The four multifractal/terrain modes transform source values by s=2*In-1 and return raw unclamped heights. Bias applies to Hybrid/Hetero/RidgedMultifractal; nonnegative Feedback applies to Hybrid/RidgedMultifractal. WeightedStrength and PingPongStrength do not apply to these four modes; inactive ports retain values/connections. A source containing Buffer requires an unconnected literal SeedStep=0. Warp kinds retain None (default), Progressive or Independent with Octaves/Lacunarity/Gain. Ordinary scalar/grain noise has no fractal controls and retains only None in this shared storage field; old embedded fractal data is unsupported. The public WT HLSL API is unchanged.

noiseDimensions.description: WT noise width: OneD=0, TwoD=1, ThreeD=2. Scalar/warp Position, Scale, Offset, Period, Direction and vector outputs follow the selected width; Offset and Period are active only with noisePeriodic. Gradient exists in all dimensions, Curl only in 2D/3D on supported bases. Triangle Voronoi and Caustics Noise accept only TwoD. Grain accepts only OneD/TwoD and retains Float2 Position/ImageSize without Offset. Discovery settings.noiseDimensions.values supplies exact ports and outputTypes. Dimension changes retain values and connections; unavailable connected ports remain visible but inactive.

noiseDistribution.description: CellularNoise/TriangleVoronoiNoise point distribution: Uniform=0 or FixedRadius=1. Jitter is a numeric input.

noiseMetric.description: CellularNoise distance metric: Euclidean=0, EuclideanSquared=1, Manhattan=2, Hybrid=3 (Manhattan plus squared Euclidean).

noiseOutput.description: CellularNoise normalized Value selection: CellValue=0, F1=1, F2=2, Add=3, Subtract=4, Multiply=5, Divide=6, DistanceToEdge=8. Smoothness=0 preserves hard results; 0..1 smooths all Value modes. Metric is ignored only for DistanceToEdge (Euclidean). Auxiliary F1/F2/CellValue/ToPoint remain hard, unfiltered first-octave geometry; there is no uint ID port.

noiseFiltering.description: Noise filtering defaults off. WT scalar/warp and both CausticsNoise algorithms use unwrapped Position derivatives and graph sample footprints in sampled branches. Fractal defaults on and uses this flag for octave attenuation in its 2D graph domain. No implicit texture mapping; grain uses its separate pixel-based settings.

noisePeriodic.description: Enables Offset and Period for scalar/warp and both Caustics Noise algorithms. Offset defaults to 0 per axis and shifts Position in input units before Scale and periodic reduction. Period defaults to 1 per axis. Caustics Noise Simplex rotates its lattice orthogonally and repeats corner hashes without blending, fitting each positive axis to max(1,floor(abs(Scale)*Period+0.5)) noise-space units (Scale=8/Period=1 retain density 8). OpenSimplex2S repeats corner hashes on both halves of an axis-aligned BCC lattice without blending copies; periodic orientation changes while nonperiodic ImproveXY and graph Scale*1.125 calibration remain. Its 578-unit Evolution loop fits 501 temporal lattice units. Nonpositive Period components disable an axis. Disabled keeps both at zero without evaluating their inputs; unconnected ports hide, connected ports remain visible but inactive, and stored values and connections survive toggling. Grain has neither control.

scatterPeriodic.description: Scatter periodic placement; independent of noisePeriodic. Count=(8,8) defines the grid per UV unit when false, or per Period when true. Period is a Float2 input defaulting to (1,1), with each component evaluated as max(abs(value),0.0001). Period hides when disabled; connected inactive ports retain their edge and value. Density, Mask, ScaleMap and RotationMap sample the canonical instance center, wrapped into Period when periodic. Source is reevaluated within instance-local 0..1; other settings use Scatter evaluation UV. ScatterInstance provides local UV, stable hash-derived 24-bit Index, Random in 0..1 and canonical Center to Source and center-sampled controls. Nested Scatter uses the innermost context; live instance-dependent buffer producers are invalid. Mode uses option: 0 Max (default), 1 Add, 2 Alpha Over. Max/Add preserve Source type; Alpha Over returns straight-alpha Color. No generated instance data is serialized.

noiseInverted.description: WhiteNoise/BlueNoise inversion, applied independently to monochrome Value and independent-RGB Color (alpha 1).

inputColorSpace.description: ConvertColor's explicit source/destination space. HSV/HSL use sRGB-encoded RGB and hue in turns. HSV excludes negative RGB but preserves HDR Value; HSL is SDR (0..1). LinearRGB, SRGB and Oklab retain signed/HDR values. Alpha is unchanged.

outputColorSpace.description: ConvertColor's explicit source/destination space. HSV/HSL use sRGB-encoded RGB and hue in turns. HSV excludes negative RGB but preserves HDR Value; HSL is SDR (0..1). LinearRGB, SRGB and Oklab retain signed/HDR values. Alpha is unchanged.

channel.description: GradientMap source channel, or HeightToNormal/HeightToDistortion channel when heightSource is Texture. Ignored for Value. Luminance uses linear RGB weights, without color conversion.

derivative.description: Height node finite-difference stencil. Radius uses bound-source texels for heightSource Texture or document pixels for Value; gradient magnitude is retained before normal encoding.

normalEncoding.description: HeightToNormal output; NormalBlend/NormalStrength input/output; NormalToDistortion/NormalLighting input encoding. PackedRGB decodes as 2*x-1; SignedXYZ is unchanged. NormalToDistortion never normalizes XY. Unconnected defaults follow the selected encoding. NormalEncode/NormalDecode have fixed directions and do not use this setting.

heightSource.description: HeightToNormal/HeightToDistortion: Texture requires a Height resource, source-texel Radius and channel/wrap/filter; Value accepts Float Height and reevaluates its branch at neighboring UVs with document-pixel Radius. Both retain derivative, Strength and FlipX/FlipY.

bufferResolution.description: Buffer: Canvas uses current render-target dimensions, including node preview resolution; Custom uses exact bufferSize. Linear float32 RGBA GPU buffers reuse allocation; bound data/context changes invalidate contents. External RenderTexture inputs and CustomFunction code conservatively refresh each owner render. No generated pixels are serialized.

bufferSize.description: Buffer Custom resolution [width,height], stored as Vector2Int. Retained but inactive for Canvas; both values must be positive. Runtime allocation remains subject to supported GPU texture dimensions.

subGraphId.description: SubGraph node reference to graph.subGraphs[].id. Ports are stable interface IDs from that definition, not pin display names.

previewExpanded.description: Per-node preview expansion, retained in the document and clipboard, including Sub Graph nodes. Editor layout only; excluded from shader compilation and rendered-image cache fingerprints.

previewHeight.description: Per-node preview presentation: false=Image, true=Height. Retained in the document, clipboard and Undo, including nested Sub Graph nodes. Does not affect shader compilation or rendered-image caches.

previewOutput.description: Output port ID shown in the node preview, shared by Image/Height. Null or an unavailable output displays the first numeric output without overwriting the saved choice. Retained in the document, clipboard and Undo; does not affect the final shader.

ShaderGraphNode.description: Stored graph node settings and literal inputs only. ApplyTransform2D (164) takes Transform: Transform2D and UV: Float2 (implicit current-pixel UV); its Local/Input Float2 outputs correspond to _Name_ToLocal/_Name_ToInput, with no Out, clipping or mask. Its inline transform resource defaults to identity (ShaderTransform.Default). Buffer (149) stores bufferResolution/bufferSize/wrap/filter, never generated GPU pixels. CausticsNoise (158) is one fixed 2D procedural kind: Algorithm option 0=OpenSimplex2S, 1=Simplex (default). Both share Position (implicit UV), Scale=(8,8), Offset=(0,0), Period=(1,1), Seed=1337, Evolution=0, Strength=1, Dispersion=1. Dispersion is an optional nonnegative Float input with no upper limit, stored in generic inputs/edges rather than a new node field. Outputs are Value (Float) and Color (Color/col, alpha=1). For nonzero dispersion, Color combines six spectral samples with the same Strength, profile, Seed, Scale, Offset, Period and Evolution. Spectrum is a Gradient input, editable inline or connected through a parameter. Six linear RGB samples at t=0,0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8,1 color the six spectral contributions from long to short wavelengths. Its default ramp runs red, orange, yellow-green, green-cyan, blue, violet. Negative RGB is clipped; gradient alpha is ignored. causticsWhiteBalance is a node setting, default true: divide each band by the sum of its channel weights (epsilon 1e-6). Channels absent from the entire palette stay zero; a black palette stays black. With balance off, each band is divided by six, retaining overall palette tint and HDR. Only Color reads Spectrum; Value is unchanged. At zero dispersion Color is grayscale Value with the default balanced palette, and can be tinted with balance off. Spectrum is stored as a generic resource input or edge; causticsWhiteBalance is stored on the node. HLSL and SVM use the same six-band weights. Their XY positions shift along a smooth bounded local direction evaluated independently from the same periodic field at a fixed offset; nonnegative Dispersion scales each signed noise-space shift. Every sample includes the selected profile and filtering; balanced nonnegative RGB stays within the scalar range. Both algorithms support Periodic, Filtering and SVM Color. WTNoiseCausticsSpectrum.hlsl supplies the procedural spectrum: broad approximate display-RGB response weights sum to white per channel, with Cauchy-shaped inverse-square wavelength shifts, not calibrated colorimetry. At nonzero dispersion green is not the unchanged scalar Value. Value is unchanged and Value-only evaluation skips the Dispersion branch and extra channel computations. At zero dispersion one noise trace supplies all weighted channels, including for a dynamic zero. Omitted Dispersion defaults to 1, with no migration. Offset/Period require noisePeriodic=true; noisePeriodic/noiseFiltering default false and support both algorithms. Value includes the complete profile and final Smoothstep in 0..1. Per unfiltered sample, OpenSimplex2S evaluates the former raw main calculation at Scale*1.125 and Strength*2, then smoothstep(0,1,0.5*exp(oldValue*3-1.5)); Simplex evaluates the former temporary calculation at Evolution*2 with unchanged Strength, then smoothstep(0,1,pow(oldValue,1/1.7)) on its exponential result. MeshGradient.description: Tensor-product cubic Bezier lattice. columns/rows are cell counts; positions and colors must each have (3*columns+1)*(3*rows+1) entries in row-major order. positions are finite local coordinates, unrestricted by 0..1 or folding. nodeModes has (columns+1)*(rows+1) row-major Smooth/Corner entries, or null for all Smooth; new nodes default to Smooth. colors are working coefficients: linear RGB for Linear, encoded RGB for Gamma, OKLab for Perceptual/Hue; alpha is a straight cubic coefficient. metric.description: All twelve modes are antialiased. EuclideanAntialiased is the default Round AA, retaining ID 4 and the original crossing-seed EDT rather than distance to continuous contour segments. Sharp/Bevel are contour-offset fields, not Euclidean SDFs. Diamond is axis-dependent L1; Square is axis-dependent L-infinity. Sharp/Bevel/Diamond/Square/MTSDF use fixed 0.25-pixel contour simplification. Sharp/Bevel/Diamond/Square/MTSDF fit straight flanks to multiple raw isocontour samples by orthogonal least squares before simplification; sampled flank deviation <= 0.6 px and supported acute caps have an engineering allowance <= sqrt(0.5) px and tip displacement within the measured 8-pixel base support, only when independently straight 16-pixel flanks agree with the base fits and sqrt(0.5) px / cosHalfTurn fits in that support; otherwise tip distance <= min(2 px, 0.6 px / cosHalfTurn). Uncertain flanks are preserved. Closed filled contours undergo NonZero union at 1e-6-pixel precision; holes and genuinely separate islands remain, while regions overlapping after reconstruction share one boundary. Paths with perimeter below 4 px bypass simplification; open and zero-area contours bypass region union. Post-union cleanup uses a 0.05-pixel budget and rejects chords crossing nonincident original or replacement boundaries or changing containment/contact states. MTSDF resolves each contour median before combining contours; alpha remains the nearest true distance. Away from the contour, a common-channel bound certifies safe RGB interpolation; suspect cells receive nine finite-contour distance checks. Geometric sign/amplification errors fall back to true distance, color-only incompatibility preserves the scalar median, and alpha is unchanged. Scalar MTSDF uses the corrected RGB median; near-boundary texels are unchanged. Reconstruction may alter subpixel detail and is not an exact original matte. MTSDF has corner-preserving RGB perpendicular/pseudo distances plus true signed Euclidean subpixel-contour distance in alpha. Old IDs 0..3 are removed. Supported concave fits may minimally shift one wall outward within the existing 0.6-pixel envelope to preserve a nearby hole, then recheck finite-tip/topology bounds. After a component merge, one bounded convex-cap enclosure pass checks arc samples and exact unsampled union vertices, without another 0.25-pixel reduction. Closed components with perimeter below 4 pixels keep finite geometry but do not generate distant Sharp/Bevel miter or MTSDF pseudo extensions. Sharp/MTSDF endpoint extensions require at least 2 pixels of straight support on both flanks after union (successive direction dot >= 0.995), with angular amplification capped at 4. Unsupported or above-cap endpoints use finite segment distance, even inside a large merged contour. Sharp resolves finite ownership within each contour before combining contour fields. Very acute or uncertain corners can round; requested Miter Limit above 4 cannot override raster safety. This is a bounded raster reconstruction, not an exact inverse. AAEDT (ID 10, UI AAEDT + 8SED) is an experimental anti-aliased Euclidean sweep-and-update transform with 8-neighbor vector propagation, adapted from Stefan Gustavson edtaa3 in a portable Burst job. It estimates the raster boundary; wide external contours remain round. It bypasses segment reconstruction and sharp/miter extensions; miterLimit and SDF contourMergeDistance are retained and validated but ignored. Source alpha (or the selected source channel) is assumed to be area coverage of a crisp edge, sampled with a box filter; blur, feather and arbitrary opacity do not give exact geometry. For coverage a in 0..1 and normalized byte threshold t=threshold/255, 0<t<1 uses c=0.5*a/t when a<=t, else c=0.5+0.5*(a-t)/(1-t). This monotonic piecewise remap sends t to 0.5 and preserves 0/1 endpoints. Thresholds 0 and 255 use binary coverage: 1 only when the selected byte-range source value exceeds threshold, otherwise 0. Outline uses fixed threshold 128. SDF supports Gradient/LinearData; MultiChannelData remains MTSDF-only. The default Round AA is unchanged. No accuracy or performance superiority is claimed. Contour (ID 11, UI Contour AA) is an experimental Euclidean distance field to finite straight segments extracted by raw marching squares from alpha or the selected source channel. Threshold crossings are linearly interpolated to subpixel endpoints. It applies no contour fitting, smoothing, simplification, corner recovery, merge/union, miter extension or MSDF channel construction. Expanded corners round. It measures the current raster threshold boundary and does not restore lost detail. It is a separate algorithm, not an AAEDT modification or a sharp-miter mode. It uses the existing source-channel, threshold, SourceEdges, offset and rendering wrapper; SDF exposes threshold and Outline uses fixed byte threshold 128. miterLimit and SDF contourMergeDistance are retained and validated but ignored. SDF supports Gradient/LinearData; MultiChannelData remains MTSDF-only. Quality comparison is experimental, with no guaranteed improvement across all inputs. Round AA remains the default at ID 4; AAEDT remains ID 10 and all existing modes are unchanged. CornerFit (ID 12, UI Corner Fit AA) and Spring (ID 13, UI Spring Simulation) are separate experimental raster-only scalar modes for SDF and Outline. CornerFit starts with raw Contour geometry, fits sides over multiple pixels and verifies candidate corners by local AA re-rasterization. Spring first applies automatic spring relaxation to the raw contour, inspired by Matusovic, Parakkat and Eisemann, Interactive Depixelization of Pixel Art through Spring Simulation (2023), DOI 10.1111/cgf.14743, then uses the same AA-tested corner proposals. The paper concerns interactive depixelization, not SDF generation; Spring is not the full interactive tool or a C++ replica. Both reject intersecting or unconfirmed extensions and retain the raw contour for ambiguous cases. Only AA-verified corners receive bounded sharp joins with continuous, local endpoint domains. miterLimit (finite 1..64, default 4) bevels excessive validated joins; it does not validate uncertain corners. Threshold is supported through coverage remapping of the selected source channel; soft/noncoverage masks give an approximate fit. SDF uses its threshold; Outline uses fixed byte threshold 128. Both use the existing scalar downstream controls and support Gradient/LinearData, never MultiChannelData. SDF contourMergeDistance is validated and retained but ignored. CornerFit is an experimental hybrid, not a known guaranteed reconstruction algorithm; neither mode promises universal sharp recovery. Round AA remains the default at ID 4 and the previous eight modes are unchanged. Rbf (ID 14, UI RBF Your SDF) is an experimental 2D adaptation of Cheng and Gingold, arXiv:2609.06209v3 with a WhimTex sharp-offset stage. It seeds cubic RBF interpolation with raster-derived Contour distances, refines implied tangent-circle points in fixed overlapping patches, extracts a half-pixel zero contour, fits supported flanks and normalizes closed regions, then applies experimental unrestricted sharp joins. Fractional contour points are passed directly, without re-rasterizing a mask. This is not the authors' full implementation or a Euclidean distance field. RBF omits angle and flank-support caps, nearest-boundary ownership and miter beveling; extra rays and overlaps may appear. Numerical degeneracy and contour-validity checks remain. Rounded input or recovered contour segments are not guaranteed to become sharp. Contour Merge and Miter Limit are ignored. Max Distance remaps the retained scalar field; Changing the retained Miter Limit value does not rebuild RBF geometry or distance. Source or threshold changes reconstruct it. No universal corner-recovery or quality advantage is claimed. Refinement is limited to 16,777,216 samples; one-dimensional input uses Round AA. Gradient/LinearData are supported; MultiChannelData remains MTSDF-only. RbfDual (ID 15, UI RBF Dual Contouring) is a separate experimental raster-only scalar algorithm for SDF and Outline. It shares the Rbf fit, extracts half-pixel cell connectivity using direct continuous RBF root searches, analytic blended normals and a bounded 2D quadratic error function (QEF), then uses the shared sharp-distance stage. It is not a faithful implementation of Occupancy-Based Dual Contouring (2024); no upstream code was copied. Existing Rbf is unchanged. The same source, threshold, sharpMode, miterLimit and scalar output controls apply. Contour Merge is retained but ignored. Max Distance remaps the retained field; the metric participates in the preparation cache key. Gradient/LinearData are supported; MultiChannelData remains MTSDF-only. Sharp-corner recovery and a quality advantage over Rbf are not guaranteed. Corner Mode applies to Sharp, MTSDF, CornerFit, Spring, Rbf and RbfDual; default Unrestricted. Other algorithms retain but ignore it. Current Sharp/MTSDF quality prototype: closed raster contours use line fits over 2/4/8/16-pixel supports, requiring agreement across scales in the two wall-normal directions with bounded longitudinal uncertainty. Supported vertices receive sharp extensions; uncertain joins receive small tangent quadratic caps (at most 0.15px displacement) and finite endpoint distances. This replaces their older fixed 8/16-pixel fitting and 2-pixel endpoint eligibility rules. Contour Merge happens before adaptive fitting. Both Corner Mode policies retain these geometric checks and MTSDF per-contour ownership. GuardedSharp additionally retains scalar finite-edge ownership and MTSDF selective interpolation correction: proximity-aware edge coloring, protected corner texels, analytic channel-crossing candidates verified against the same pseudo-distance field, RGB median and alpha unchanged at integer texels. Unrestricted omits that interpolation pass and scalar finite ownership. Miter Limit bevels scalar joins only in GuardedSharp; MTSDF ignores it. Max Distance is display remapping only. CornerFit, Spring, Rbf and RbfDual are unchanged. Very acute low-resolution corners may still round or differ with threshold; no universal reconstruction guarantee. This supersedes earlier Sharp/MTSDF fitting and correction descriptions.

RBF omits angle and flank-support caps, nearest-boundary ownership and miter beveling; extra rays and overlaps may appear. Numerical degeneracy and contour-validity checks remain. Rounded input or recovered contour segments are not guaranteed to become sharp. Contour Merge and Miter Limit are ignored. Max Distance remaps the retained scalar field; Changing the retained Miter Limit value does not rebuild RBF geometry or distance. Source or threshold changes reconstruct it. No universal corner-recovery or quality advantage is claimed. Refinement is limited to 16,777,216 samples; one-dimensional input uses Round AA. Gradient/LinearData are supported; MultiChannelData remains MTSDF-only. RbfDual (ID 15, UI RBF Dual Contouring) is a separate experimental raster-only scalar algorithm for SDF and Outline. It shares the Rbf fit, extracts half-pixel cell connectivity using direct continuous RBF root searches, analytic blended normals and a bounded 2D quadratic error function (QEF), then uses the shared sharp-distance stage. It is not a faithful implementation of Occupancy-Based Dual Contouring (2024); no upstream code was copied. Existing Rbf is unchanged. The same source, threshold, sharpMode, miterLimit and scalar output controls apply. Contour Merge is retained but ignored. Max Distance remaps the retained field; the metric participates in the preparation cache key. Gradient/LinearData are supported; MultiChannelData remains MTSDF-only. Sharp-corner recovery and a quality advantage over Rbf are not guaranteed. Corner Mode applies to Sharp, MTSDF, CornerFit, Spring, Rbf and RbfDual; default Unrestricted. Other algorithms retain but ignore it. Current Sharp/MTSDF quality prototype: closed raster contours use line fits over 2/4/8/16-pixel supports, requiring agreement across scales in the two wall-normal directions with bounded longitudinal uncertainty. Supported vertices receive sharp extensions; uncertain joins receive small tangent quadratic caps (at most 0.15px displacement) and finite endpoint distances. This replaces their older fixed 8/16-pixel fitting and 2-pixel endpoint eligibility rules. Contour Merge happens before adaptive fitting. Both Corner Mode policies retain these geometric checks and MTSDF per-contour ownership. GuardedSharp additionally retains scalar finite-edge ownership and MTSDF selective interpolation correction: proximity-aware edge coloring, protected corner texels, analytic channel-crossing candidates verified against the same pseudo-distance field, RGB median and alpha unchanged at integer texels. Unrestricted omits that interpolation pass and scalar finite ownership. Miter Limit bevels scalar joins only in GuardedSharp; MTSDF ignores it. Max Distance is display remapping only. CornerFit, Spring, Rbf and RbfDual are unchanged. Very acute low-resolution corners may still round or differ with threshold; no universal reconstruction guarantee. This supersedes earlier Sharp/MTSDF fitting and correction descriptions.

miterLimit.description: Finite 1..64, default 4. In GuardedSharp, bevels joins above this ratio for Sharp, CornerFit, Spring, Rbf and RbfDual. Ignored in Unrestricted and MTSDF. No separate fixed angular rounding cap.

contourMergeDistance.description: Experimental SDF-only contour merge in current raster/render pixels, independent of distance remap width. Finite 0..2 inclusive; default 0 disables it. Applies only to Sharp and MTSDF; other modes retain but ignore it, with the same validation. One pass merges disjoint consecutive-vertex pairs within one contour, shortest eligible pairs first, to their midpoints. Each pair is within the requested distance; each original vertex is used at most once. Never merges different loops or builds multi-vertex clusters. A topology conflict rolls back the whole batch. Existing safety protections remain. May shift short details and does not guarantee restored sharpness.

threshold.description: Byte threshold 0..255. In AAEDT, normalize to t=threshold/255 and remap coverage monotonically so t maps to 0.5 while 0/1 remain unchanged. Extreme thresholds use binary coverage: 1 only when the selected byte-range source value exceeds threshold, otherwise 0. CornerFit and Spring also support the threshold through coverage remapping; fitting is approximate for soft masks or values that do not represent area coverage. Remaining modes keep their existing threshold behavior.

encoding.description: Gradient is the default. Gradient/LinearData use the RGB median for MTSDF before artistic remapping. MultiChannelData requires metric MTSDF and encodes raw linear RGBA as saturate(0.5 + 0.5*d/maxDistanceNormalization) (0 selects auto). Alpha is true signed Euclidean distance to the reconstructed subpixel contour, not coverage, binary-bitmap distance or an exact original matte. MTSDF uses constrained multi-sample corner fitting followed by fixed 0.25-pixel simplification. Sampled flank deviation <= 0.6 px; supported acute caps have an engineering allowance <= sqrt(0.5) px and tip displacement within the measured 8-pixel base support, only when independently straight 16-pixel flanks agree with the base fits and sqrt(0.5) px / cosHalfTurn fits in that support; otherwise tip distance <= min(2 px, 0.6 px / cosHalfTurn). Closed filled contours undergo NonZero union before generating edge colors. Holes and genuinely separate islands remain; overlapping reconstructed regions share one boundary. Tiny paths bypass simplification; open and zero-area contours bypass union. MTSDF resolves each contour median before combining contours; alpha remains the nearest true distance. Away from the contour, a common-channel bound certifies safe RGB interpolation; suspect cells receive nine finite-contour distance checks. Geometric sign/amplification errors fall back to true distance, color-only incompatibility preserves the scalar median, and alpha is unchanged. Scalar MTSDF uses the corrected RGB median; near-boundary texels are unchanged. Use blendMode Overwrite for raw RGBA composition/export because Normal treats alpha as coverage and can alter data. Standalone ordinary FX/effect-layer inputs receive rendered RGBA. Position, Contour Offset, inside/outside ranges, Inverted, Profile and palette are bypassed. Supported concave fits may minimally shift one wall outward within the existing 0.6-pixel envelope to preserve a nearby hole, then recheck finite-tip/topology bounds. After a component merge, one bounded convex-cap enclosure pass checks arc samples and exact unsampled union vertices, without another 0.25-pixel reduction. Closed components with perimeter below 4 pixels keep finite geometry but do not generate distant Sharp/Bevel miter or MTSDF pseudo extensions. Sharp/MTSDF endpoint extensions require at least 2 pixels of straight support on both flanks after union (successive direction dot >= 0.995), with angular amplification capped at 4. Unsupported or above-cap endpoints use finite segment distance, even inside a large merged contour. Sharp resolves finite ownership within each contour before combining contour fields. inputMode.description: Shared Graph/Code source. None reads transparent black; Texture uses inputTexture; Layer uses inputLayerId; CompositeBelow reads the lower composition including external backdrops through Pass Through ancestors. Isolated/clipped groups stop inheritance. Self and above are excluded. Blending is independent; Crossfade mixes before/after without accumulating alpha.

inputLayerId.description: Source layer/group ID. Retained and remapped even when inputMode is not Layer. Empty selections read transparent black. Validation rejects unresolved nonempty selected IDs and self/cyclic dependencies.

ShaderLayerBehaviour.description: Procedural Shader layer with independent Graph (default) and Code modes. Switching mode converts nothing. Both graph and code state, declarations and values persist in every writing mode. Code uses WhimTex HLSL ApplyFX/@param: draftCode is an editable draft, workingCode is the last successfully compiled source, and draftCodeParameters holds its accepted declarations and current values. Rendering uses workingCode, never the draft. UV is local procedural UV. Shared Input supplies color/SampleInput in Code and SampleInput nodes in Graph; None and missing sources read transparent black. Output is straight RGBA followed by ordinary layer transform, FX and blending; reading CompositeBelow does not replace that composition. Stored texture parameters in both modes are validated/remapped. Shared inputLayerId is remapped even while inactive; only selected sources affect rendering dependencies and stamps.

fillMode.description: Shared figure fill: None=0, Solid=1, LinearGradient=2, RadialGradient=3, SquareGradient=4, AngularGradient=6, Freeform=7. Freeform uses the independent freeform point field. Shape fill is an additional overall gate. Full, FullOptimized and Compact retain inactive fill settings.

gradient.description: Independent WhimTexGradient palette, default black-to-white Perceptual/Balanced/Clamp. Required non-null in gradient modes, even with painting disabled. Retains HDR colors, alpha, midpoints, colorMode, interpolation, huePath, chromaCorrection, smoothness, colorSpace and wrapMode; wrapping follows the angular-only gradientRepetitions multiplier.

freeform.description: Independent Freeform points in normalized layer-local coordinates. Retained in inactive modes; required non-null when Freeform is active, including disabled painting.

gradientStart.description: Finite normalized layer-local y-up anchor, allowed outside 0..1. Linear start; center for other gradients. Pixel metric: Shape current canvas dimensions before layer Transform; Vector and Boolean Group referenceSize. Changing this anchor does not change the layer transform or the other paint.

gradientEnd.description: Finite normalized layer-local endpoint. Sets radius and orientation from gradientStart in reference pixels. Radial uses length, Square max(abs(rotated coordinates)). Angular is the positive CCW angle from this ray divided by one turn and multiplied by gradientRepetitions, with its seam on the ray. Equal anchors yield t=0 for every gradient type.

gradientRepetitions.description: Finite angular-gradient repetitions, at least 0.0001; default 1. AngularGradient only: one period spans 360/gradientRepetitions degrees before palette wrapping. Retained and validated in every paint mode, including disabled painting.

strokeMode.description: Independent stroke paint: None disables painting without clearing settings; Solid uses strokeColor; four gradient modes use strokeGradient; Freeform uses strokeFreeform. The stroke boolean remains an additional gate. Every JSON mode retains inactive stroke settings.

strokeGradient.description: Independent WhimTexGradient palette, default black-to-white Perceptual/Balanced/Clamp. Required non-null in gradient modes, even with painting disabled. Retains HDR colors, alpha, midpoints, colorMode, interpolation, huePath, chromaCorrection, smoothness, colorSpace and wrapMode; wrapping follows the angular-only strokeGradientRepetitions multiplier.

strokeFreeform.description: Independent Freeform points in normalized layer-local coordinates. Retained in inactive modes; required non-null when Freeform is active, including disabled painting.

strokeGradientStart.description: Finite normalized layer-local y-up anchor, allowed outside 0..1. Linear start; center for other gradients. Pixel metric: Shape current canvas dimensions before layer Transform; Vector and Boolean Group referenceSize. Changing this anchor does not change the layer transform or the other paint.

strokeGradientEnd.description: Finite normalized layer-local endpoint. Sets radius and orientation from strokeGradientStart in reference pixels. Radial uses length, Square max(abs(rotated coordinates)). Angular is the positive CCW angle from this ray divided by one turn and multiplied by strokeGradientRepetitions, with its seam on the ray. Equal anchors yield t=0 for every gradient type.

strokeGradientRepetitions.description: Finite angular-gradient repetitions, at least 0.0001; default 1. AngularGradient only: one period spans 360/strokeGradientRepetitions degrees before palette wrapping. Retained and validated in every paint mode, including disabled painting.

strokePosition.description: Relative to the body contour. Shape retains Inside=0, Center=1, Outside=2; Vector uses a different numeric ordering.

strokeJoin.description: Outline join, independent of the body's corner descriptors.

strokeCap.description: Ends of stroke dashes. Separate from lineCap, which shapes the Line/Arc body ends.

miterLimit.description: Maximum miter ratio before a Miter join becomes Bevel. Retained for other joins.

dashPattern.description: Alternating dash/gap lengths, always in multiples of strokeWidth, independent of stroke position. Empty/null is solid; odd lists repeat twice. Shape has no dashPatternRelative field.

dashOffset.description: Phase along the contour in document pixels, never a stroke-width multiplier. Shape retains its transform metric: ordinary resizing keeps width, dash metrics and feather in document pixels; perspective retains the existing local approximation. Vector scales its local stroke geometry.

lineCap.description: Line/Arc body end caps. Independent of strokeCap and the outline dash pattern.

edgeMode.description: Glyph rasterization: HintedAA (default) uses grid-fitted antialiasing; Antialiased uses antialiasing without hinting; Pixel uses binary glyph coverage, snapped glyph placement and nearest sampling by default. Explicit filtering and FX can soften Pixel output; this is not final-alpha quantization. The mode is part of the saved-appearance key.

layoutOffset.description: Layout translation in local document pixels before rasterization, independent of the layer transform. Preserved across Point/Frame switches.

gradientScope.description: Text normalizes one field over all glyph bounds; Character repeats shared anchors over each nonempty glyph rectangle, not advance or whitespace. Paint changes do not rebuild glyph coverage. Original Edge Mode remains in control.

fallbackPixelScale.description: Pixel scale of the retained font fallback bitmap. Missing-font rendering rescales its placement by current pixelScale/reference without changing retained typography.

fallbackPaint.description: Optional missing-font Character paint snapshot. Deflate-compressed little-endian RGBA float32, bottom-up, exactly fallbackPaintWidth*fallbackPaintHeight*16 decoded bytes; at most 768 KiB compressed. Full float precision including HDR and alpha. Bound to fallbackPaintKey; cannot be repainted without glyphs.

shapes.description: One figure per authored layer; multiple contours, including holes, belong to that figure. Older arrays with several figures are accepted only for normalization into an ordinary group with one figure per child, retaining the original shell and shared transform/FX.

referenceSize.description: Physical document pixel size at creation. Coordinates and tangent offsets are layer-local y-up; stroke widths, dash offsets and Feather use these reference pixels. Relative dash lengths multiply strokeWidth. All follow the layer transform.

feather.description: Finite total soft transition width in vector reference pixels; scales with the vector geometry like stroke width. Smoothstep of signed distance to fill and actual stroke/dash boundaries, not a blur. Zero preserves the existing renderer. Step ignores Feather without clearing either stored setting.

featherPosition.description: Inside fades inward, Outside outward, Centered equally across the painted boundary. Layer-wide setting, not a VectorShape or Boolean Group style field. Retained when Feather is zero or Edge Mode is Step.

brushDraft.description: Last stroke's original coverage and editable rebuild controls. Retained in all write modes, Undo and TIFF until the next stroke replaces it.

coverage.description: Original unmodified coverage bytes in bottom-up row-major order, exactly width*height bytes after base64 decoding; at most 1048576 bytes. Not a rendered preview.

frame.description: Original mask rectangle [x,y,width,height] in normalized layer-local y-up coordinates. Reframing a figure updates this mapping, not the coverage bytes.
